title: Medical Advisor Gastroenterology
description:
**Company Description** **About AbbVie**


AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience \- and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

 **Job Description**  

We are seeking a **Medical Advisor** in the **Gastroenterology** therapeutic area — a passionate and driven professional who is eager to make an impact and join our dynamic team.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to our medical strategy and work closely with key stakeholders, reporting directly to the Medical Lead.


Main responsibilities include:

* To warrant the medical know\-how of the Affiliate regarding the relevant therapeutic areas of assigned products (including AbbVie products, competitors and general knowledge of specific diseases).
* To drive Medical activities to support the Brand Strategy and integrate it into the Brand Plan
* To represent the Italian Affiliate in the relevant therapeutic Corporate Medical Development setting.
* To prepare the medical plan of activities for each product of the relevant area, on an annual basis and to update it as appropriate.
* To contribute to the design and improvement of AbbVie Medical Department Italy (AMDI) systems and processes (e.g. AMDI SOPs and Guidelines) with the aim of ensuring best practice as well as compliance to all applicable regulations and Company procedures.
* To undergo training relevant to the function and to be familiar and updated with the AbbVie local and international procedures relevant to the Job Description.


Additional responsibilities:

* To manage the budget of the relevant therapeutic area (including local clinical studies) as approved in the medical plan.
* To be responsible for:
	+ The design of local AMDI clinical studies.
	+ The review, approval, fulfillment of contract agreements of Investigator Initiated Studies (IISs).
* To foster the participation of the Affiliate to International clinical trials and provide the Medical Lead/Head Medical Affairs/Affiliate Medical Director and Research and Development with appropriate comments regarding the design and implementation of International protocols.
* To identify potential sites for carrying out International and local clinical studies and maintain a liaison with them throughout the study conduct in cooperation with Clinical Research Department.
* To maintain a continuous relationship with Key thought Leaders and External Expert as to the relevant therapeutic area.
* To address queries by physicians regarding the relevant products (including medical support on marketed products to the Pharmacovigilance Unit).
* To design or participate to the design of AbbVie events (e.g. Satellite Symposia), warranting an appropriate medical support to the Commercial Divisions and in agreement with the International and local SOPs.
* To provide medical\-scientific update on TA, products and competitors, as agreed with the Commercial Divisions and to provide medical training when requested/necessary.
* To review promotional material before the approval of the Head Scientific Service, warranting the appropriateness of its medical content and the independence of assessment.
* To review the Summary of Product Characteristics and Insert Leaflets, prepared by Regulatory Affairs, before final approval of the Head Scientific Service, as to products of the relevant therapeutic area.
* To support the Scientific Training Specialist(s) of the relevant Medical Affairs Unit in preparing the annual scientific training plan for the sales force and its delivery, including the preparation of product handbook(s).
* To provide medical support to the Pharmacovigilance Unit as to AEs reported in clinical trials on the relevant products.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Medical **degree strongly preferred**, or Italian equivalent to Laurea Magistrale in life science/chemistry related topics.
* Minimum of 3 years’ working experience in clinical context or in pharmaceutical/biotechnological industry, in a scientific/medical role, within cross functional teams
* **Experience in gastroenterology therapeutic area**
* Ability to transform strategies into feasible and realistic actions
* Ability in leading, motivating, and coordinating cross functional team
* Excellent knowledge of the health sector and of its development
* Effective management of the work in a matrix structure
* Knowledge of financial principles and processes
* Fluency in written and oral English (Minimum Common European Framework Level: C1\).


Preferred:

* Medical Specialization, PHD in medical sciences
* Proven success in pharmaceutical/biotechnological context

  

**Additional Information**  

Your total reward package at AbbVie will be made up of multiple components, including compensation, well\-being and benefits.  

In this role, you will receive base pay and annual short term incentive subject to AbbVie's global policy. You will also receive a number of benefits including life assurance, medical plan, flexible benefits, etc.


In this role, you will also be entitled to receive a company car.


Full details of our comprehensive package will be shared during the recruitment process.


The national collective bargaining agreement applicable to this position is B011 – CCNL Chemical\-Pharmaceuticals Industry.


AbbVie is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to operating with integrity, driving innovation, transforming lives and serving our community. Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled.

description:
**Tiered Approach**

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:


* **Tier 0** : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed\-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026\.
* **Tier 1** : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed\-term (FTA) appointments
* **Tier 2** : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
* **Tier 3 or no tier indicated** : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.


**Office / Unit / Project Description**

The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) is the leading organization for sustainable development within the UN system and acts as the key integrator for achieving the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). UNDP operates across headquarters, regional, and country levels, leveraging local expertise alongside global insights to deliver effective advocacy and solutions. For six decades, UNDP has worked with partners to lift millions out of poverty and expand opportunities for all.


UNDP’s Strategic Plan 2026–2029 is grounded in the determination to eradicate poverty—the greatest global challenge and a prerequisite for achieving the 2030 Agenda. Through the Strategic Plan, UNDP will continue supporting countries in advancing high human development while protecting the planet. Four strategic objectives—prosperity for all, effective governance, crisis resilience, and a healthy planet—guide its direction, powered by three accelerators: digital and artificial intelligence (AI) transformation, gender equality, and sustainable finance. All efforts are underpinned by a strong commitment to human rights and to leaving no one behind.


Within UNDP, the Bureau for Policy and Programme Support (BPPS) brings together world\-class policy expertise, flagship global programmes, and collaborative innovation and learning networks. BPPS ensures that UNDP is not only ready for the future but actively helps shape it with governments and partners. Working closely with the Crisis Bureau (CB), BPPS supports countries in navigating complex development and crisis contexts, integrating risk considerations into programming, and strengthening results\-based management, innovation, and data\-driven approaches.


The Global Policy Network (GPN) is central to this effort, mobilizing technical expertise to advance UNDP’s strategic objectives and signature solutions. Within the GPN, BPPS is responsible for developing policy and guidance, providing technical advice to Country Offices, representing UNDP in multi\-stakeholder fora, and supporting UN inter\-agency coordination across thematic areas.


The Italy Africa Digital Flagship initiative is implemented in close collaboration with national governments, the Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and Italian public and private sector partners. It focuses on advancing digital public infrastructure, digital identity systems, agritech solutions, and data\-driven governance, contributing to sustainable development and inclusive economic growth.


Within this framework, the Digital Transformation Specialist will provide senior technical leadership for the digital transformation components of the Italy–Africa Digital Development Flagship Programme. The role will focus on ensuring that digital solutions, feasibility studies, technical specifications, and implementation approaches are technically sound, interoperable, scalable, secure, and aligned with national digital priorities, international standards, and relevant donor and financing requirements. The incumbent will work closely with the Project Specialist, UNDP Country Offices, national digital counterparts, technical teams, and external partners, providing technical inputs and quality assurance to support coherent programme design and implementation.


The assignment is situated within a complex and evolving multi\-stakeholder environment, characterized by tight timelines, advanced stages of project design, and the need to align diverse partner expectations and requirements. Additional challenges include the coordination of multi\-country interventions, adaptation to specific donor formats and procedures (including AICS requirements), and ensuring consistency across projects developed in different national contexts together with the project team.


**Duties and Responsibilities**

Under the strategic guidance and supervision of the UNDP Rome Centre Senior Advisor, and in close coordination with the Project Specialist, the r Digital Transformation Specialist will serve as the primary technical authority for digital architecture, digital strategy, and ICT systems design within the programme.


The role is responsible for ensuring that digital solutions developed under the Flagship are technically sound, interoperable, scalable, and aligned with international standards and the evolving digital regulatory environments of the partner countries.


The incumbent will work at the intersection of government policy, technology architecture, and development finance, providing senior\-level technical advisory services to national governments, UNDP teams, and strategic partners. The Senior Digital Transformation Specialist will perform the following functions:


1\. Preparatory and Feasibility Studies Technical Leadership


* Lead the technical design and quality assurance of executive feasibility studies under the Italy\- Africa Digital Flagship Programme in selected countries.
* Oversee the architecture design of the feasibility studies, including GIS platforms, remote sensing integration, telemetry systems, IoT sensors, and climate advisory dashboards, ensuring full technical interoperability between physical infrastructure and digital decision\-support systems.
* Define the full technical architecture of the studies, covering high\-performance computing, cloud and hybrid deployment models, data storage and sovereignty frameworks, cybersecurity and disaster recovery systems, interoperability layers, and a sequenced pipeline of AI use cases aligned with national priorities.
* Lead the definition of data governance models, interoperability standards, and responsible AI frameworks in compliance with international regulatory requirements across both studies.
* Ensure all digital system specifications are produced to a standard sufficient to support international competitive tendering, CDP financing appraisal, and seamless transition to implementation.
* Coordinate with the UNDP Rome Centre, national digital agencies, MAECI, and Italian private sector and technology partners to ensure technical coherence, institutional ownership, and alignment with the broader Digital Flagship programme architecture.

2\. Lead Digital Strategy and Architecture


* Lead the design and continuous refinement of the digital transformation strategy for the programme across all four focus countries, ensuring technical coherence, scalability, and alignment with national digital agendas.
* Define and oversee enterprise architecture frameworks for proposed digital public infrastructure, including digital identity systems, e\-government platforms, connectivity infrastructure, data governance frameworks, and interoperability layers.
* Conduct and validate technical feasibility analyses and ICT landscape reviews in close collaboration with UNDP Country Offices and national counterparts.
* Provide authoritative technical advisory to government ministries, national digital agencies, and implementing partners on system architecture, technology stack selection, cybersecurity requirements, and data protection frameworks.
* Lead technical due diligence for proposed digital solutions, ensuring alignment with international standards (ITU, ISO, NIST), open\-source and digital public goods principles, and sustainable vendor\-neutral architecture.

3\. Lead Technical Management and Quality Assurance


* Lead the technology workstream to ensure on\-time, on\-budget delivery of digital components.
* Establish and manage an integrated programme governance structure for the digital workstream, including technical steering committees, change control boards, risk registers, and issue logs.
* Develop and maintain programme\-level technical documentation including the solution design documents, technical specifications, and supporting the procurement documentations (RFPs/TORs for ICT services and vendors), test strategies, and acceptance criteria.
* Oversee technical quality assurance and acceptance testing of delivered digital systems, ensuring contracted deliverables meet defined technical and functional standards before certification of satisfactory completion.
* Provide input to project formulation documents (ProDocs), results frameworks, and monitoring and evaluation plans as they relate to digital components.

4\. Cybersecurity, Data Governance and Risk Management


* Lead the development of cybersecurity strategies and frameworks for digital systems designed under the Flagship, informed by industry standards such as ISO/IEC 27001 and NIST CSF, with appropriate localization for each country context.
* Advise on data protection legislation, data sovereignty considerations, privacy\-by\-design principles, and alignment with applicable international frameworks (e.g., GDPR\-equivalent standards).
* Conduct and document IT risk assessments, articulating technical risks in terms accessible to non\-technical stakeholders; develop mitigation strategies and contingency plans.
* Ensure that all digital systems procured or developed under the programme incorporate robust access control, audit trail, and incident response capabilities.

5\. Build Strategic Partnership, Stakeholder Engagement and Capacity Development


* Serve as the senior technical interlocutor with government counterparts (Ministries of ICT, National Digital Agencies, Regulators) and strategic partners including international financial institutions, bilateral donors, and private sector entities.
* Provide technical inputs to investment cases, concept notes, and bankable project documents, translating complex technical architectures into language suitable for development finance decision\-making.
* Design and deliver capacity development sessions, technical workshops, and knowledge\-sharing events for government officials and UNDP teams on digital transformation, emerging technologies, and ICT governance.
* Represent UNDP at high\-level technical conferences, inter\-agency forums, and bilateral meetings, contributing to the programme’s visibility and positioning as a centre of technical excellence.

6/ Innovation, Emerging Technologies and Facilitate Knowledge Management


* Monitor global trends in digital public infrastructure (DPI), open\-source digital public goods (DPGs), AI\-enabled public services, cloud adoption, and emerging connectivity technologies (e.g., low\-orbit satellites, 5G/6G), and advise on their applicability in the programme context.
* Support the identification and piloting of innovative digital tools that can accelerate SDG delivery in the programme’s thematic areas (agriculture, health, climate, digital identity, tax administration).
* Contribute to UNDP’s global knowledge base through documented lessons learned, technical briefs, and replicable frameworks derived from the Flagship’s implementation experience.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organisation.


4\. Institutional Arrangement


The Digital Transformation Specialist will report directly to the Head of the Political Affairs and Strategic Initiatives. The incumbent will be embedded within the UNDP Rome Centre and will work in close coordination with relevant teams, as well as with UNDP Country Offices in participating countries.


Under the direction of the UNDP Rome Centre Senior Advisor, the Digital Transformation Specialist will conduct regular technical coordination with UNDP Country Offices including, Côte d’Ivoire, Ghana, Senegal, and Mozambique, with the Italian Government (MAECI/DGCS), CDP, AICS, and with national digital counterparts.


**Competencies**

**Core competencies**

**Achieve Results** LEVEL 3: Set and align challenging, achievable objectives for multiple projects, have lasting impact
  

**Think Innovatively** LEVEL 3: Proactively mitigate potential risks, develop new ideas to solve complex problems
  

**Learn Continuously** LEVEL 3: Create and act on opportunities to expand horizons, diversify experiences
  

**Adapt with Agility** LEVEL 3: Proactively initiate and champion change, manage multiple competing demands
  

**Act with Determination** LEVEL 3: Think beyond immediate task/barriers and take action to achieve greater results
  

**Engage and Partner** LEVEL 3: Political savvy, navigate complex landscape, champion inter\-agency collaboration
  

**Enable Diversity and Inclusion** LEVEL 3: Appreciate benefits of diverse workforce and champion inclusivity


**Cross\-Functional \& Technical Competencies**

**Digital \- Co\-creation:** Ability to design and facilitate a process that enables a diverse group of stakeholders to solve a common problem, develop a practice, or create knowledge together. Ability to embrace diversity, work with a diverse group of stakeholders understand their interests, perspectives and views and tap into to them as a source for creativity. Ability to facilitate processes and create conditions that are open for diverse inputs, stimulate collaboration and sharing.
  

**Digital \- Digital ecosystems:** Knowledge of how they work, understanding of the opportunities and challenges for governments and society
  

**Digital \- Digital transformation design:** Practical and strategic skills in digital transformation for governments and organisations.
  

**Digital \- Policy/regulations for digital and emerging technology:** Ability to design or advise on regulations and policy for digital and emerging technology.
  

**Digital \- Portfolio design \& management:** Ability to identify leverage points in systems and design interventions that address them. The value of the interventions is determined not in isolation, but as part of the overall portfolio and their coherence. Ability to design processes that extract learning on an ongoing basis from existing portfolios, so that learning accrues over time and new options for action are continuously generated. Build a learning ecosystem around a complex development challenge: being able to mobilise a variety of stakeholders and help them learn and work together. Understand key principles of systems and complexity theory.
  

**Business Direction \& Strategy \- System Thinking:** Ability to use objective problem analysis and judgement to understand how interrelated elements coexist within an overall process or system, and to consider how altering one element can impact on other parts of the system
  

**Business Management \- Monitoring \& Evaluation** : Ability to systematically monitor results of strategies, programmes, and activities with a view to make sure that they are being implemented effectively; Ability to provide managers and key stakeholders with regular feedback and reporting on the consistency or discrepancy between planned activities and programme management and results. Ability to make independent judgment of the management and results of strategies, programmes and activities based on set criteria and benchmark, keeping in mind the needs and concerns of client, current and upcoming. Knowledge and understanding of monitoring and evaluation frameworks, concepts, methodologies, systems, processes, and tools. Ability to make an independent judgement based on set criteria and benchmarks. Ability to anticipate client's upcoming needs and concerns.  

  



**Required Skills and Experience**

**Education:**

* Advanced university degree (master’s degree or equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Electrical / Telecommunications Engineering, Public Administration, Public Policy, or International Development with a strong ICT focus, Business Administration with specialization in Digital Transformation is required. Or
* A first\-level university degree (bachelor’s degree) in the areas stated above, in combination with an additional two years of qualifying experience will be given due consideration in lieu of the advanced university degree

**Experience:**

* Minimum of 7 years (with master’s degree) or 9 years (with bachelor’s degree) of progressively responsible experience in digital transformation, ICT programme management, and digital strategy.
* At least 5 years’ experience in an international development context and/or with government entities in developing countries
* Demonstrated expertise in enterprise/solution architecture design for large\-scale digital government systems required
* Proven experience leading large\-scale digital transformation programmes or complex ICT projects in an international development context, preferably within the UN system or with multilateral institutions required
* Proven experience advising national governments on digital transformation strategy, digital public infrastructure, or e\-government platforms required.
* Track record of managing complex, multi\-country, multi\-stakeholder digital programmes in an international or UN system environment required.
* Experience with cybersecurity principles, data governance frameworks, and privacy\-by\-design methodologies required.
* Experience in developing ICT procurement strategies, technical specifications (RFP/TOR), and vendor evaluation frameworks for public sector digital projects required.
* Experience in translating complex technical concepts for non\-technical audiences including senior government officials, donors, and development finance partners required.
* Experience working in or with countries in West and/or East Africa on digital transformation or e\-government initiatives desirable.
* Experience in digital public goods (DPG) ecosystems, open\-source platforms (e.g., digital Identity, OpenCRVS, DHIS2\), and interoperability frameworks (e.g., GovStack, X\-Road) desirable.
* Experience with Italy’s development cooperation ecosystem (MAECI/DGCS, AICS, CDP/ICF) and bilateral finance mechanisms desirable.
* Familiarity with UNDP programme management cycles, Results\-Based Management (RBM), and UNDP’s POPP procurement procedures for ICT services desirable.
* Experience applying PMI/PMBOK, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum methodologies within a UN or international development programme context desirable.

**Languages:**

Fluency in English is required.


Working knowledge in Italian is desirable **.**

title: CMC Biopharma Regulatory Consultant — Ecolab Life Sciences
description:
Ecolab is the global leader in water, hygiene and energy technologies and services that provide clean water, safe food, abundant energy and healthy environments. We deliver comprehensive programs and services to the food, energy, healthcare, industrial and hospitality markets in more than 160 countries.


Ecolab Life Sciences is committed to accelerating growth in Biopharma by helping customers solve complex purification, process optimization, and regulatory change challenges. The Biopharma Technical Consultant role is a key enabler of this strategy, bringing deep technical expertise, customer insight, and influence to support adoption of Ecolab chromatography resin and purification solutions.


The Biopharma Technical Consultant will provide customer\-facing technical consulting for downstream purification, chromatography resin performance, resin conversion, comparability strategy, and regulatory change management. This role works closely with commercial, regulatory, R\&D, application laboratory, and field teams to create customer value, support business conversion, and strengthen Ecolab’s position as a trusted technical partner in Biopharma.


This role will be based in EUROPE with a requirement to travel to regional and international Biopharma customer sites as needed.


The Biopharma Technical Consultant is responsible for providing expert technical and regulatory consulting to support the use, evaluation, and conversion of Ecolab chromatography resin and purification solutions in Biopharma manufacturing. The role advises customers on resin performance, downstream purification process optimization, comparability considerations, validation approaches, and post\-approval change strategies, including alignment with relevant regulatory expectations such as ICH Q5E, ICH Q12, and regional variation requirements.


The role provides a critical link between customer technical teams and Ecolab’s internal commercial, regulatory, marketing, R\&D, and application laboratory teams. It supports business growth by translating customer purification and regulatory challenges into value\-based solutions, identifying compelling events for resin adoption, and helping customers de\-risk change while improving quality, efficiency, supply security, and total cost of ownership.

**How you'll make an impact:**

* Provide technical consulting services that leverage Ecolab’s expertise in chromatography resin performance, downstream purification, and regulatory change management to help commercial teams understand customer needs and increase account revenue.
* Act as a pre\-sales and customer\-facing technical expert for Biopharma opportunities, especially where resin conversion, process optimization, supply security, or regulatory change complexity are key decision drivers.
* Work alongside customers at their facilities to identify opportunities to improve purification performance, product quality, operational efficiency, resin lifetime, and risk mitigation while maintaining regulatory compliance.
* Support or manage customer resin evaluation, comparability, and validation activities by advising on methodology, experimental design, small\-scale model qualification, accelerated resin aging studies, and regulatory filing strategy.
* Support customer change control processes by contributing technical documentation, risk assessments, validation rationale, training material, and regulatory change packages in a timely and accurate manner.
* Build trusted relationships with technical and regulatory decision makers, including Process Development, MSAT, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Procurement, and CDMO stakeholders.
* Use data, customer insight, and business acumen to articulate the value of Ecolab purification solutions, including total cost of ownership, process robustness, supply continuity, and regulatory change de\-risking.
* Serve as an internal and external subject matter expert by presenting at customer meetings, technical forums, industry events, webinars, and conferences to strengthen Ecolab’s credibility in Biopharma purification.
* Support product, service, and digital innovation by capturing customer pain points, identifying compelling events such as supply disruptions or patent cliffs, and partnering with marketing, R\&D, regulatory, and commercial teams to develop scalable Biopharma offerings.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor of Science degree or equivalent in Life Sciences, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Chemical Engineering, Bioprocess Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Experience in Biopharma manufacturing, process development, MSAT, purification sciences, technical service, quality, regulatory affairs, or a related customer\-facing technical role.
* Strong understanding of downstream purification processes, especially chromatography applications used in biologics manufacturing.
* Experience troubleshooting technical challenges, supporting investigations, evaluating process performance data, and developing practical corrective or improvement actions.
* Experience designing and delivering technical training or customer\-facing technical presentations.
* Strong understanding of GMP, quality systems, change control, validation principles, and regulatory expectations for Biopharma manufacturing.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills, analytical thinking, customer discovery, problem solving, and stakeholder influencing skills.
* Ability to travel 50%\+ of time in region, potentially at short notice.
* Ability to travel globally periodically.
* Clean driver’s license and ability to apply for travel visas.
* Fluent in English.

**Additional Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree or PhD in Life Sciences, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Chemical Engineering, Bioprocess Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Hands\-on experience with Protein A chromatography, affinity chromatography, ion exchange chromatography, resin lifetime studies, column packing, CIP optimization, or downstream purification troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of change control, comparability, post\-approval change management, and regulatory filing strategies for biologics.
* Strong knowledge of ICH Q5E, ICH Q8, ICH Q9, ICH Q10, ICH Q12, GMP expectations, FDA post\-approval change pathways, EMA variation requirements, or other regional Biopharma regulatory frameworks.
* Experience working with monoclonal antibodies, biosimilars, CDMOs, or large\-scale biologics manufacturing environments.
* Ability to build business cases and value stories that connect technical performance, regulatory risk reduction, supply security, and total cost of ownership.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior technical, quality, regulatory, and commercial stakeholders in complex customer environments.
* Experience presenting at industry conferences, customer technical forums, webinars, or professional associations such as ISPE, PDA, CASSS, or BIO.
* Ability to take initiative, work independently, prioritize multiple projects, and deliver with strong follow\-through.
* Flexibility to manage multiple customer, commercial, and innovation projects at the same time while meeting deadlines.
* Knowledge of regional regulatory frameworks e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, NMPA, PMDA, Health Canada, TGA].


No immigration or relocation sponsorship available for this opportunity

At Ecolab, we prioritize our talent\-first philosophy by creating the most capable and diverse team to excel at our nearly three million customer sites. Building on a century of innovation, our 48,000 associates help deliver comprehensive science\-based solutions, data\-driven insights and world\-class service to advance food safety, maintain clean and safe environments, and optimize water and energy use, and improve operational efficiencies and sustainability for customers in the food, healthcare, life sciences, hospitality and industrial markets in more than 170 countries around the world. Our solutions not only enhance operational efficiency but also contribute to sustainability and public health, making a positive impact on the world. We are committed to eliminating unnecessary complexities and embracing a beginner's mindset, continuously seeking new perspectives and innovative solutions to stay ahead in a rapidly changing world.

title: Senior Consultant - SAP Ariba
description:
*The chance to build a better future is right in front of you*

  


**Do Work That Matters \- Il tuo ruolo e le tue responsabilità**

  



Vuoi fare un lavoro che sia davvero significativo e di impatto? In KPMG avrai l'opportunità di aiutare clienti, società, colleghe e colleghi ad affrontare e risolvere le sfide più attuali e complesse. KPMG Advisory affianca le imprese nella trasformazione del business model, nel miglioramento e nella digitalizzazione dei processi, supportando i clienti anche nell'analisi e gestione dei rischi e nelle operazioni di finanza straordinaria.

  



Entrando a far parte del **Team Enterprise Platforms**, lavorerai su progetti di implementazione ed evoluzione SAP con focus su **SAP Ariba per clienti della Pubblica Amministrazione**, contribuendo ai processi end\-to\-end di procurement nel rispetto della normativa sui contratti pubblici.  




  

Nello specifico, ti occuperai di:

  


* **Analisi dei requisiti** e traduzione in soluzioni SAP Ariba, guidando sessioni di design con i referenti **Procurement** e **Ufficio Gare** del cliente
* Configurazione dei moduli **Ariba Sourcing** e **Contract Management** (eventi RFx, aste, workspace contrattuale), garantendo tracciabilità e **trasparenza dei processi di gara**
* Configurazione dei moduli Ariba Buying, Guided Buying e Catalog Management, inclusa la gestione dei flussi di requisition, approvazione e cataloghi (CIF)
* Gestione del ciclo di vita degli ordini d'acquisto e dei processi di qualifica e onboarding fornitori tramite Ariba Network
* Integrazioni tra Ariba e SAP S/4HANA/ECC nei flussi Procure\-to\-Pay, incluso il supporto alla configurazione del Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG)
* Supporto a testing, formazione utenti e change management, e redazione della documentazione funzionale di progetto

  




Lavorerai a stretto contatto con clienti del settore pubblico, in contesti di **Pubblica Amministrazione** centrale e locale, enti regolatori, sanità, istruzione e società a partecipazione pubblica, collaborando con team multidisciplinari

  


**Come As You Are – Le tue competenze e caratteristiche**

  



Questa opportunità è perfetta per te se:

  


* Hai maturato esperienza consolidata su progetti SAP Ariba, sia lato Sourcing/Category che P2P/Buying, con almeno un ciclo completo di implementazione o roll\-out
* Conosci i moduli Ariba Sourcing, Contract Management, Buying e Guided Buying, e sai gestirne la configurazione in autonomia
* Hai familiarità con la gestione dei cataloghi (CIF), i flussi di approvazione e l'onboarding fornitori su Ariba Network
* Sei in grado di condurre in autonomia workshop di analisi e gestire l'interfaccia diretta con il cliente
* Hai familiarità con le integrazioni tra Ariba e SAP S/4HANA/ECC
* Buona conoscenza dell'inglese, attitudine al lavoro in team e disponibilità a trasferte

  


**Your Future With Us \- Cosa troverai in KPMG**

  



* Un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, equo e che rispetta, incoraggia e valorizza le diversità
* Un contesto stimolante e dinamico che incentiva la creatività e il lavoro di squadra
* Modalità di lavoro ibrida, per promuovere un sano equilibrio tra vita lavorativa e personale
* Programmi di formazione e sviluppo avanzati per rimanere sempre aggiornati
* Mindset internazionale e progettualità innovative
* Iniziative incentrate sul benessere psicofisico

  


*Inquadramento ai sensi del CCNL Commercio, RAL indicativa compresa tra € 31\.000 e € 41\.000 per la qualifica di Senior Consultant e tra € 38\.000 e € 51\.000 per la qualifica di Assistant Manager, determinata sulla base di criteri oggettivi con riferimento specifico alle competenze e all'esperienza del profilo rispetto ai requisiti della posizione.*


*In ottemperanza alla normativa vigente, non raccogliamo né utilizziamo informazioni sulle retribuzioni percepite in rapporti di lavoro attuali o precedenti. Le nostre procedure di selezione sono, inoltre, improntate a criteri oggettivi e neutrali rispetto al genere.*

  


**Together for Better – I nostri valori e il nostro impegno**

  



Leadership, lavoro in team, rispetto di ogni individualità, approfondimento continuo, trasparenza, impegno verso la comunità, integrità: questi sono i Valori di KPMG che danno vita a un ambiente aperto allo scambio di idee e di conoscenza, che permette ai nostri professionisti di esprimere tutto il loro potenziale.



Grazie all'impegno nel favorire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, il nostro Network risulta conforme agli standard dei requisiti ISO 30415, sul Sistema di Gestione per la Diversità e l'Inclusione, e UNI PdR 125, relativa alla parità di genere. All'interno del nostro Impact Plan \- Our Impact Plan (kpmg.com) \- trovi riassunte tutte le azioni concrete che stiamo portando avanti su tematiche ambientali, sociali e di governance (ESG).

  



Unisciti a noi!

  



I tuoi dati saranno trattati nel pieno rispetto delle disposizioni del Regolamento (UE) n. 679/2016 (General Data Protection Regulation \- "GDPR") e successive modifiche. Per ulteriori informazioni, consultare l'informativa sulla privacy di KPMG.

  



KPMG Advisory S.p.A. garantisce le pari opportunità.

  


**The chance to build a better future is right in front of you**
----------------------------------------------------------------


### **Do Work That Matters – Your Role and Responsibilities**



Do you want to do work that is truly meaningful and impactful? At KPMG you will have the opportunity to help clients, society, and colleagues tackle and solve today's most pressing and complex challenges. KPMG Advisory supports businesses in transforming their business model and in improving and digitizing processes, also supporting clients in risk analysis and management, as well as in extraordinary finance operations.



Joining the Enterprise Platforms Team, you will work on SAP implementation and evolution projects with a focus on SAP Ariba for Public Sector clients, contributing to end\-to\-end procurement processes in compliance with public procurement regulations.

  



Specifically, you will:


* Analyze requirements and translate them into SAP Ariba solutions, leading design sessions with the client's Procurement and Tender Office stakeholders
* Configure the Ariba Sourcing and Contract Management modules (RFx events, auctions, contract workspace), ensuring traceability and transparency of tender processes
* Configure the Ariba Buying, Guided Buying, and Catalog Management modules, including the management of requisition and approval flows and catalogs (CIF)
* Manage the purchase order lifecycle and supplier qualification and onboarding processes through Ariba Network
* Support integrations between Ariba and SAP S/4HANA/ECC in Procure\-to\-Pay flows, including support for configuring the Cloud Integration Gateway (CIG)
* Support testing, user training, and change management activities, and draft project functional documentation

  



You will work closely with Public Sector clients, across Central and Local Public Administration, regulatory bodies, healthcare, education, and publicly owned companies, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams.

  


### **Come As You Are – Your Skills and Qualities**



This opportunity is right for you if:


* You have gained solid experience on SAP Ariba projects, on both the Sourcing/Category and P2P/Buying side, with at least one full implementation or roll\-out cycle
* You are familiar with the Ariba Sourcing, Contract Management, Buying, and Guided Buying modules, and can independently manage their configuration
* You are familiar with catalog management (CIF), approval flows, and supplier onboarding on Ariba Network
* You are able to independently lead analysis workshops and manage the direct interface with the client
* You are familiar with integrations between Ariba and SAP S/4HANA/ECC
* Good command of English, a collaborative attitude, and availability to travel


### **Your Future With Us – What You Will Find at KPMG**


* An inclusive, fair working environment that respects, encourages, and values diversity
* A stimulating and dynamic environment that fosters creativity and teamwork
* Hybrid working arrangements, promoting a healthy work\-life balance
* Advanced training and development programs to stay continuously up to date
* An international mindset and innovative projects
* Initiatives focused on psychophysical wellbeing

  



Standard employment contract under the collective labour agreement for the commerce sector, with a starting gross annual salary ranging from €31,000 to €41,000 for the Senior Consultant position and from €38,000 to €51,000 for the Assistant Manager position. The salary is determined on the basis of objective criteria, including the candidate's skills and experience assessed against the requirements of the role.



In accordance with applicable legislation, we do not collect or use information relating to remuneration received in current or previous employment. Our selection procedures are based on objective and gender\-neutral criteria.

  


### **Together for Better – Our Values and Our Commitment**



Leadership, teamwork, respect for every individual, continuous learning, transparency, community engagement, and integrity: these are the Values of KPMG, which give life to an environment open to the exchange of ideas and knowledge, enabling our professionals to reach their full potential.



Through our commitment to fostering an inclusive workplace, our Network complies with the ISO 30415 standard (Diversity \& Inclusion Management System) and UNI PdR 125 (Gender Equality). Within our Impact Plan \- Our Impact Plan (kpmg.com) \- you will find a full overview of the concrete actions we are taking on Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) topics.

  



Join us!

  



Your data will be processed in full compliance with EU Regulation No. 679/2016 (General Data Protection Regulation \- "GDPR") and subsequent amendments. For further information, please refer to KPMG's privacy policy.

  



KPMG Advisory S.p.A. is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Senior Renewable Energy Project Manager
description:
**About the Role:**

Frishtey Engineering and Energy Solutions Italia SRL, we help turn ambitious sustainability targets into practical, deliverable energy projects. We support renewable\-energy developments across solar, storage, electrical infrastructure, energy efficiency, and grid\-connected systems.

We are looking for a **Senior Renewable Energy Project Manager** who can take full ownership of complex energy projects from initial feasibility through construction, commissioning, and final handover. You will coordinate engineers, contractors, consultants, suppliers, clients, and regulatory stakeholders while ensuring that every project meets its technical, commercial, environmental, and scheduling requirements.

You are not simply updating project trackers. You are responsible for converting development plans into operational renewable\-energy assets. You will identify risks early, remove delivery barriers, and keep multidisciplinary teams aligned from the first technical review to energisation.

**Why Work With Us?**

**The Environment:** Our Rome office is located near the EUR business district, with convenient access to engineering firms, public institutions, commercial centres, and major transport connections.

**Project Impact:** The projects you manage will contribute directly to Italy’s renewable\-energy and decarbonisation goals. Your work will have measurable environmental and commercial value.

**Project Ownership:** You will have responsibility for key decisions involving schedules, budgets, contractors, technical priorities, and project risks.

**Multidisciplinary Collaboration:** You will work alongside electrical engineers, civil engineers, environmental consultants, grid specialists, procurement professionals, construction managers, and financial stakeholders.

**Growth:** You will receive support for technical certifications, project\-management training, renewable\-energy conferences, and professional events that keep your industry knowledge current.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**End\-to\-End Project Management:** Lead renewable\-energy projects from feasibility studies, permitting, and detailed design through procurement, construction, commissioning, and operational handover.

**Project Planning:** Develop detailed programmes, delivery milestones, resource plans, and project\-control procedures. Monitor progress and implement corrective actions when delays occur.

**Budget Management:** Prepare and manage project budgets, cost forecasts, cash\-flow requirements, contractor payments, contingencies, and financial reports.

**Technical Coordination:** Coordinate civil, electrical, mechanical, grid\-connection, and environmental workstreams. Ensure that technical deliverables are complete, consistent, and suitable for construction.

**Contractor and Supplier Management:** Manage engineering consultants, equipment suppliers, EPC contractors, subcontractors, and specialist service providers. Monitor performance against contractual commitments.

**Permitting and Compliance:** Coordinate with authorities, municipalities, grid operators, and environmental bodies to support permitting, approvals, and regulatory compliance.

**Construction Oversight:** Monitor site activities, construction quality, safety performance, schedule adherence, and technical progress through regular meetings and inspections.

**Risk Management:** Identify technical, regulatory, financial, environmental, and scheduling risks. Develop mitigation strategies and escalate critical issues before they affect delivery.

**Stakeholder Management:** Provide clear project updates to clients, investors, internal management, consultants, and external partners. Present progress, risks, financial performance, and proposed decisions.

**Commissioning and Handover:** Coordinate testing, commissioning, energisation, documentation, defect resolution, and formal handover to operations and maintenance teams.

**Team Leadership:** Guide project engineers, coordinators, planners, and technical specialists. Set expectations, assign responsibilities, and maintain accountability across the project team.

**What We Are Looking For:**

**Experience:** At least 6 years of experience in renewable energy, engineering project management, infrastructure delivery, construction, or a related technical environment.

**Sector Knowledge:** Strong experience in solar photovoltaic systems, battery energy storage, energy\-efficiency projects, electrical infrastructure, or grid\-connected energy developments.

**Leadership Background:** Demonstrated experience managing multidisciplinary teams, contractors, consultants, and external stakeholders.

**Education:** A degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Energy Engineering, Environmental Engineering, or a related discipline.

**Technical Knowledge:** Strong understanding of renewable\-energy project lifecycles, grid connections, permitting, procurement, construction, commissioning, and operational handover.

**Project Tools:** Experience with project\-management and planning tools such as Microsoft Project, Primavera P6, Excel, document\-control platforms, or equivalent systems.

**Commercial Awareness:** Ability to manage budgets, contracts, procurement packages, supplier quotations, variations, claims, and project forecasts.

**Language Skills:** Professional Italian is required. Good working English is preferred for technical documentation, international suppliers, and stakeholder communication.

**Professional Credentials:** Project\-management certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, IPMA, or equivalent qualifications are an advantage.

**Mindset:** You are practical, organised, and commercially aware. You can balance technical quality with budget and schedule requirements, and you know when a project needs deeper analysis and when it needs a prompt decision.

The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) contributes to the achievement of the 2030 Agenda through FAO Strategic Framework by supporting the transformation to MORE efficient, inclusive, resilient and sustainable agrifood systems, for better production, better nutrition, a better environment, and a better life, leaving no one behind.


The independent Office of Evaluation (OED) conducts independent evaluations of FAO’s strategies, programmes, and projects at the global, regional, and national levels. OED is led by a Director who reports to the FAO Governing Bodies and the Director\-General, and is mandated to generate credible and useful evidence to inform decisions, support oversight, and contribute to accountability. OED evaluates FAO strategies, initiatives, programmes, and projects covering strategic, thematic, country programme, and project evaluations.  

As part of its mandate, OED evaluates projects addressing climate change mitigation and adaptation, including a growing number of projects funded by the Global Environment Facility (GEF) and the Green Climate Fund (GCF) in the Agriculture, Forestry and Other Land Use (AFOLU) sector. These projects routinely involve ex\-ante and ex\-post greenhouse gas (GHG) estimates produced using tools such as EX\-ACT (Environmental eXternalities ACcounting Tool), NEXT (Nationally Determined Contribution Expert Tool), GLEAM (Global Livestock Environmental Assessment Model) and the IPCC GHG Inventory Software.  

While all three tools may produce IPCC\-consistent estimates for AFOLU projects, they differ substantially in methodological depth, scope, scenario\-handling capabilities, and intended use.

 **Reporting Lines**


The GHG Accounting Specialist will report directly to the OED Director and to the OED Better Environment Coordinator. The Specialist will work in close coordination with the OED GCF Coordinator, and with OED Lead Evaluators and Evaluation Managers, and will liaise as needed with FAO technical divisions (including ESA, OCB and CFI), GHG tool developers, and external evaluation consultants.

 **Technical Focus**


GHG accounting and carbon flux estimation in the AFOLU sector; application and critical assessment of GHG accounting tools (EX\-ACT, IPCC Inventory Software, NEXT, GLEAM); alignment with IPCC Guidelines (2006, 2013 Wetlands Supplement, 2019 Refinement); methodological guidance and quality assurance for project\-level GHG estimates in FAO/GCF/GEF evaluations; and capacity development for OED staff and evaluation consultants.

 **Tasks and responsibilities**


The GHG Accounting Specialist will be responsible for the following:

*Technical Advisory and Methodological Guidance*

* Provide systematic technical guidance to OED staff and external evaluation consultants on the appropriate selection, application, and interpretation of GHG accounting tools (EX\-ACT, IPCC Inventory Software, NEXT) across different project phases (design, mid\-term, final/ex\-post).
* Conduct a comparative analysis of results when using different approaches to measuring GHG emissions or reductions in emissions, specifically the IPCC Inventory Software, IPCC, and EX\-ACT.
* Advise on the harmonization of inputs, emission factors, tier levels, and scenario assumptions when cross\-validating GHG estimates produced by different tools or different evaluators across the portfolio.
* Assist in identifying methodological divergences, calculation errors, or data gaps in project\-level GHG assessments submitted to OED, and advise on corrective actions.
* Stay current with updates to GHG accounting tools, IPCC Guideline revisions, and evolving donor expectations for GHG reporting under the Enhanced Transparency Framework (ETF), and communicate relevant changes to OED staff.

*Quality Review of GHG Estimates in OED Evaluations*

* Review and validate GHG estimates (ex\-ante, mid\-term and ex\-post) included in FAO projects evaluated by OED, particularly GCF\- and GEF\-funded projects, ensuring consistency with IPCC Guidelines.
* Verify the completeness, accuracy, transparency, and comparability of GHG accounting applied in evaluated projects, covering all relevant AFOLU categories (land\-use change, forestry, livestock, soils) and carbon pools (above\-ground biomass, below\-ground biomass, soil organic carbon, dead organic matter, harvested wood products).
* Assess whether the tier level (Tier 1, 2, or 3\) and the land representation (Approach 1, 2 or 3\) applied are appropriate given available data, project scale, and reporting requirements, and flag cases where a simplified approach may materially affect results.
* Apply cross\-validation practices by re\-running or spot\-checking GHG estimates using a second tool where feasible, and by cross\-checking data sources against national statistics, default IPCC values, or field measurements, in line with Recommendation 5 of the Comparative Study.
* Identify non\-AFOLU components of a project (e.g. Energy, Waste, Industrial Processes and Product Use (IPPU)) and advise on how these should be addressed in the GHG accounting. (recognizing that AFOLU source/sink categories and carbon pools are unlikely to cover the entire set of emission sources associated with a project in agriculture or forestry);

*Transparency and Documentation*

* Support the development and roll\-out of OED’s standardized guidance document for methodological choices, capturing: assumptions and emission factors used; data sources and their justification; tiers and approaches applied; parameters and units; and comparison notes where multiple tools or sources are used.
* Maintain or contribute to a decision log for methodological choices made in OED evaluations, improving auditability and consistency across the portfolio.
* Ensure that any differences between OED’s re\-estimated GHG figures and original project estimates are clearly documented, explained, and reflected in evaluation reports.

*Capacity Development and Helpdesk Support*

* Provide targeted technical training to OED staff and external consultants to build familiarity with EX\-ACT, the IPCC Inventory Software, and NEXT, and with OED’s methodological standards for GHG\-related evaluation findings.
* Serve as an internal helpdesk resource, responding to technical queries from OED evaluators and consultants during active evaluations involving GHG accounting.
* Contribute to the development of training materials, methodological annexes, and guidance notes that facilitate consistent tool selection and application across OED’s evaluation portfolio.
* Collaborate with the evaluation team integrating GHG\-related indicators and data into baseline, midterm, and final evaluation survey instruments, ensuring that data collected are suitable for ex\-ante and ex\-post GHG quantification.
* Liaise as needed with FAO technical divisions (ESA, OCB), tool developers (IPCC TFI, ESA, OCB), and external institutions (GCF, GEF) to ensure OED’s guidance remains aligned with current best practice.

*Strategic Support to OED Climate and Environment Evaluations*

* Advise OED management on the criteria for identifying projects that require use of the IPCC Inventory Software for alignment with National Greenhouse Gas Inventories (NGHGIs) and the ETF, including the NDCs and thresholds related to project scale, duration, sectoral contribution, and budget (Recommendation 4 of the Comparative Study).
* Support OED’s engagement with national partners, ministries, and NGHGI teams to facilitate earlier alignment of project data with national reporting needs, where relevant to ongoing evaluations.
* Contribute, as requested, to OED’s participation in system\-wide evaluation initiatives and to the development of methodological guidance for climate\-related evaluations across the UN system.

 **CANDIDATES WILL BE ASSESSED AGAINST THE FOLLOWING**

 **Minimum Requirements**

* Advanced University degree/University degree from an institution recognized by the International Association of Universities (IAU)/UNESCO in environmental science, climate change, natural resource management, forestry, agronomy, agricultural economics, or a closely related discipline relevant to the work of the Organization. Consultants with bachelor's degree need two additional years of relevant professional experience
* At least seven (7\) years of relevant professional experience in GHG accounting, carbon flux estimation, or climate change mitigation assessment, with demonstrated focus on the AFOLU sector.

description:

MEDICAL LEAD ONCOLOGY
  
  

.
  
  

Servier è alla ricerca di una/un Medical Lead Oncology altamente qualificata/o per definire e guidare la strategia medica per l'area terapeutica oncologica. La figura agirà come punto di riferimento scientifico interno ed esterno, assicurando che tutte le attività siano condotte in conformità con le normative vigenti e gli standard etici del Gruppo.
  
  

In stretta collaborazione con il Direttore Medico, il/la Medical Lead Oncology assicurerà il pieno allineamento con la strategia trasversale della filiale, coordinando un team dedicato al raggiungimento dell'eccellenza scientifica e clinica.
  
  

Sotto la guida del Direttore Medico, è responsabile delle seguenti attività:
  
  

Coordina la progettazione e l'implementazione del Piano Medico strategico locale per l'Area Terapeutica di riferimento, in pieno allineamento con gli altri Dipartimenti.
  
In coerenza con il Piano Strategico, assicura la definizione e l'implementazione del Piano di Attività volto a soddisfare i bisogni dei pazienti.
  
Gestisce il budget disponibile per le attività pianificate nella propria area terapeutica di riferimento, partecipando attivamente ai processi finanziari aziendali.
  
  

In linea con i valori e la cultura del Gruppo, è responsabile di:
  
  

Coordinare, motivare e sviluppare i propri riporti diretti (MSL manager, Medical Advisor e MSL), assicurando la definizione di obiettivi chiari, fornendo feedback regolari e supportando la loro crescita professionale.
  
Elevare lo standard di Eccellenza Medica nell'area oncologica ottimizzando il Piano Medico strategico e potenziando le competenze del team.
  
Garantire che tutte le attività mediche siano condotte in conformità con le normative vigenti, il Codice Etico di Farmindustria e le procedure interne (Compliance).
  
Assicurare il supporto medico in tutti i progetti realizzati all'interno di Servier, collaborando con tutti i dipartimenti e con l'Istituto di Ricerca Servier.
  
Garantire la competitive intelligence dell'area assegnata, coordinando la raccolta e la condivisione di insight medici consolidati a livello locale e globale.
  
Garantire l'integrità scientifica e l'etica in tutte le comunicazioni e attività mediche.
  
  

RESPONSABILITÀ E ATTIVITÀ PRINCIPALI
  
  

**Strategia Medica:** Progettare, implementare e dirigere i piani di medical affairs per i prodotti in commercio e in pipeline.
  
**Strategia e Trasformazione:** Promuovere la visione strategica della filiale, guidando la diffusione delle relative iniziative e comunicando i successi internamente.
  
**Leadership Scientifica:** Agire come principale esperto clinico, interpretando dati preclinici e clinici e supervisionando la generazione di evidenze mediche.
  
**Collaborazione Cross\-funzionale:** Collaborare con i team commerciali, marketing e operativi per guidare lo sviluppo del prodotto e l'accesso al mercato.
  
**Coinvolgimento degli Stakeholder:** Assicurare una collaborazione efficace con i Therapeutic Area Experts (TAE) e i professionisti sanitari.
  
**Gestione del Team:** Guidare e potenziare il team medico dedicato all'Oncologia, favorendo l'innovazione e l'implementazione di successo delle attività mediche in linea con i piani.
  
**Compliance e Regolamentazione:** Garantire che tutte le informazioni mediche, i materiali educativi e gli studi clinici soddisfino gli standard industriali e governativi.
  
  

COMPETENZE E REQUISITI
  
  

**Formazione:** Laurea in Medicina (M.D.) (preferibile) o in discipline scientifiche (PhD, Farmacia, Biotecnologie).
  
**Esperienza :** Più di 5 anni di esperienza nei Medical Affairs dell'industria farmaceutica o biotecnologica, con almeno 3 anni dedicati esclusivamente a un portfolio oncologico. Successo documentato nella guida di almeno un lancio di prodotto locale in ambito oncologico (tumori solidi o neoplasie ematologiche).
  
**Acume Scientifico in Oncologia:** Competenza nell'interpretare e commentare dati complessi di ricerca clinica oncologica, diagnostica molecolare, biologia tumorale e biomarcatori.
  
**Pianificazione Strategica:** Forte capacità di sviluppare e implementare strategie mediche a lungo termine allineate con gli obiettivi di business nel campo oncologico. Ciò comporta lungimiranza nell'identificare le tendenze emergenti, analisi del panorama competitivo e definizione di piani chiari e attuabili per guidare l'innovazione e la leadership di mercato.
  
**Analisi dei Dati e Gestione delle Performance:** Capacità di analizzare criticamente dati medici e di studi clinici complessi, interpretare i risultati e tradurli in insight operativi. Ciò include la competenza nell'uso di strumenti pertinenti per la visualizzazione dei dati, l'analisi statistica e il monitoraggio delle prestazioni per guidare il processo decisionale strategico e ottimizzare i risultati in oncologia.
  
**Conoscenza del Mercato Locale:** Rete professionale preesistente e consolidata con i principali centri oncologici del Paese, reti ospedaliere e gruppi cooperativi terapeutici.
  
**Project \& Change Management:** Capacità di guidare e gestire progetti complessi nell'area dei medical affairs e dell'oncologia, garantendo una consegna puntuale e un'efficace allocazione delle risorse. Comprovata esperienza nel navigare e implementare il cambiamento organizzativo, favorendo l'adattabilità e guidando i team attraverso le transizioni mantenendo il focus sugli obiettivi strategici.
  
**Leadership del Team sul Campo:** Capacità di gestire in una struttura a matrice o supervisionare direttamente i Medical Science Liaisons (MSL) locali e i Medical Advisor per coordinare un'efficace esecuzione sul campo.
  
**Coaching:** Comprovata capacità di fare da mentore, sviluppare e ispirare team medici e scientifici. Ciò include fornire feedback costruttivi, promuovere un ambiente di apprendimento e responsabilizzare le persone affinché raggiungano il loro pieno potenziale e contribuiscano efficacemente agli obiettivi oncologici.
  
**Lingue:** Eccellente conoscenza della lingua inglese (scritta e parlata).
  
  

**Cosa Offriamo:**  

Contratto a tempo indeterminato
  
Range retributivo (RAL) previsto tra 90\.000 € e 105\.000 € , commisurato all'esperienza \+ benefits.
  
Un ambiente dinamico che valorizza l'integrità scientifica e l'innovazione, con l'obiettivo di rispondere ai bisogni insoddisfatti dei pazienti oncologici.
  
Modalità di lavoro ibrida
  
  

Qualunque sia la tua area di competenza, il tuo lavoro all'interno del gruppo Servier contribuisce al progresso terapeutico a servizio dei bisogni dei pazienti. Farai parte di team riconosciuti per la loro eccellenza scientifica e potrai esprimere al massimo le tue potenzialità in un ambiente professionale che ti incoraggia a crescere. Percorsi di onboarding personalizzati, opportunità di mobilità, corsi di formazione di qualità, gestione responsabile, spirito di squadra... Tutto questo e molto altro in un ambiente di lavoro che ha molto a cuore il tuo benessere.
  
  

Il gruppo Servier è impegnato nel progresso terapeutico per rispondere alle necessità dei pazienti. Facciamo in modo che l'eterogeneità dei nostri dipendenti sia una fonte di ricchezza per la realizzazione di questa vocazione.

description:
**Il Ruolo:**

Roma è rinomata per la sua dedizione all'eccellenza e al patrimonio naturale e, in Indri Botanical Extracts \& Wellness Europa S.r.l., applichiamo esattamente questo standard al settore della salute e del benessere. Produciamo estratti botanici di prima qualità e formulazioni naturali conformi ai più severi standard normativi internazionali. Crediamo che l'assicurazione qualità non sia solo una questione di conformità normativa, ma serva a costruire la fiducia in ogni singolo prodotto che realizziamo. Siamo alla ricerca di un/a **Quality Assurance \& Compliance Assistant (m/f/d)** che ci aiuti a mantenere ed elevare i nostri standard di qualità. Non ti limiterai ad archiviare report: il tuo compito sarà salvaguardare l'integrità del prodotto. Lavorerai a fianco dei nostri team di qualità e delle operation, facendo da ponte tra le complesse direttive normative europee e i processi produttivi quotidiani. Sarai la voce della qualità e della conformità in tutte le nostre attività.

**Perché Lavorare Con Noi?**

* **L'Ambiente:** I nostri uffici e stabilimenti si trovano nella viva e dinamica città di Roma. Promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro pulito, moderno e strutturato, dove la precisione incontra l'innovazione—il tutto affiancato da colleghi disponibili e una cultura di apprendimento continuo.
* **La Qualità al Primo Posto:** Non c'è bisogno che sia tu a convincerci dell'importanza della compliance. Sappiamo già quanto valga. L'assicurazione qualità è integrata in ogni singola fase della nostra strategia aziendale.
* **Standard di Settore:** Operiamo nel rigoroso rispetto delle normative GMP, degli standard ISO e delle regolamentazioni UE, offrendoti un contatto diretto con sistemi di gestione della qualità di alto livello.
* **Crescita:** Avrai accesso a corsi di formazione professionale, certificazioni e programmi di sviluppo linguistico per far avanzare continuamente la tua carriera nell'ambito QA.

**Responsabilità Principali:**

* **Documentazione e Compliance:** Mantenere, aggiornare e organizzare le Procedure Operative Standard (SOP), i dossier di lotto e la documentazione normativa. Garantire la completa conformità agli standard del mercato UE.
* **Monitoraggio della Qualità:** Effettuare controlli di routine sulle materie prime botaniche e sui prodotti finiti, verificando le specifiche e i protocolli di conformità prima della loro immissione sul mercato.
* **Preparazione degli Audit:** Collaborare alla preparazione della documentazione per gli audit interni, alla standardizzazione delle checklist e supportare i team lead durante le ispezioni normative esterne.
* **CAPA e Non Conformità:** Prestare supporto nell'analisi delle deviazioni di qualità, nella registrazione dei report di non conformità (NCR) e nel monitoraggio delle Azioni Correttive e Preventive (CAPA) fino al loro completamento.
* **Supporto Cross\-Funzionale:** Collaborare a stretto contatto con i team di produzione, supply chain e affari regolatori per garantire che la conformità qualitativa sia perfettamente integrata nei flussi di lavoro quotidiani.

**Requisiti Richiesti:**

* **Esperienza:** 1–3 anni di esperienza pratica in Assicurazione Qualità, Controllo Qualità o Compliance nei settori botanico, farmaceutico, alimentare o cosmetico.
* **Istruzione:** Laurea di primo o secondo livello in Chimica, Farmacia, Biologia, Scienze e Tecnologie Alimentari o disciplina scientifica affine.
* **Conoscenze Normative:** Solida conoscenza delle Norme di Buona Fabbricazione (GMP) e delle principali regolamentazioni UE sulla sicurezza dei prodotti.
* **Competenze Linguistiche:** Italiano (madrelingua o livello C1/C2\) richiesto per le operazioni quotidiane e la documentazione normativa. Inglese (livello B2/C1\) essenziale per la documentazione internazionale e le comunicazioni transfrontaliere.
* **Attitudine:** Sei una persona precisa, analitica e proattiva. Comprendi che una compliance rigorosa tutela sia l'azienda sia il consumatore finale.
